equations.name: Scouting Total
equations.description: Per-match scouting total from the imported scoring components.

equations.name: Auto
equations.description: Average derived autonomous contribution per match.

equations.name: Cycle
equations.description: Average derived transition and cycle contribution per match.

equations.name: Endgame
equations.formula: average(endgameFuelTeam + if(contains(scouting.teleopClimbAttempt, "park"), 8, if(contains(scouting.teleopClimbAttempt, "climb") || contains(scouting.teleopClimbAttempt, "successful"), 20, 0)) + if(contains(scouting.autoClimbAttempt, "climb") || contains(scouting.autoClimbAttempt, "successful"), 15, 0))
equations.description: Average derived endgame contribution per match, including fuel and climb scoring.

equations.name: Auto Fuel Share
equations.description: Scouted auto fuel share converted to a decimal fraction.

equations.name: Auto Fuel Share Alliance
equations.description: Alliance auto fuel-share denominator with the spreadsheet's fallback to 1 when entries are missing.

equations.name: Auto Fuel Team
equations.formula: if(autoFuelShareAlliance == 0, if(allianceCount(scouting.hasEntry) > 0, valueOr(tba.hubScore.autoPoints, 0) / allianceCount(scouting.hasEntry), 0), valueOr(autoFuelShare / autoFuelShareAlliance * valueOr(tba.hubScore.autoPoints, 0), 0))
equations.description: Allocated auto fuel for this robot.

equations.name: Auto % Shooting
equations.description: Estimated share of auto spent shooting based on the two scouted roles.

equations.name: Auto Max Fuel Possible
equations.description: Implied auto fuel capacity after adjusting for time spent shooting.

equations.name: Tele-Op Max Fuel Possible
equations.formula: autoMaxFuelPossible + transitionMaxFuelPossible + shift1MaxFuelPossible + shift2MaxFuelPossible + shift3MaxFuelPossible + shift4MaxFuelPossible + endgameMaxFuelPossible
equations.description: The sheet's total max-fuel estimate across all phases, including auto.

equations.name: Total Fuel Scored
equations.formula: autoFuelTeam + transitionFuelTeam + shift1FuelTeam + shift2FuelTeam + shift3FuelTeam + shift4FuelTeam + endgameFuelTeam
equations.description: Allocated total fuel across all phases for this robot and match.
